app GeneratedMachines
Given
 Job { label:text, attempts:int=0, status:enum(idle,queued,ready)=idle machine }
 policy Job read=public
When
 crud Job by=members fields=label,attempts
 ## Machine transitions and ordinary writes share one reserved record version.
 scenario start(job:Job,accept:bool) -> int by=members
  do
   transition job.status idle -> queued
   require job.status==queued
   set job {attempts=job.attempts+1}
   require accept
   transition job.status queued -> ready
   return job.attempts
 ## The selected finite Match arm stages a write before a later requirement.
 scenario matchWrite(job:Job,accept:bool) -> int by=members
  do
   match job.status
    case idle
     set job {attempts=job.attempts+1}
    case queued
     set job {attempts=job.attempts+2}
    case ready
     set job {attempts=job.attempts+3}
   require accept
   return job.attempts
 ## This declared edge fails on idle and rolls back the preceding ordinary write.
 scenario mismatch(job:Job) -> int by=members
  do
   set job {attempts=job.attempts+1}
   transition job.status queued -> ready
   return job.attempts
Then
 page / title="Machine runtime"
  list Job empty="No jobs"
   text row.label,row.status
